nativeModuleAbi.description: Frozen in-process driver extension contract. A shared library exporting the init symbol registers driver operation tables over the engine keyspace; the host verifies its checksum before loading and never unloads it. Any language producing a C shared library can implement one; capi/testdata/nativememdb is the C reference.

driverBundles.description: RocksDB driver bundle; requires the packaged RocksDB runtime and notices.
Berkeley DB C API extension. KVLite does not publish its native binary; the application owner supplies a separately licensed Berkeley DB library.

extensions.description: Optional JSON/HTTP server and Go remote-client extension. It is linked only by callers that choose it; embedded C bundles do not include it. The standalone executable bundle contains no statically linked storage driver and opens an installed driver C-shared module at runtime.

Optional Redis-compatible RESP server extension. It is linked only by callers that choose it; embedded C bundles do not include it. The standalone executable bundle contains no statically linked storage driver and opens an installed driver C-shared module at runtime.

artifacts.description: Owns selected KVLite driver directories. Release builds carry kvlite_no_linked_extensions and launch verified standalone protocol executables; pass --linked-extensions only for a development/convenience profile.
Embedded FFI library used by thin language wrappers.
